written: 2026-11-25 before lead.py was run. Friend charts, Q4 2026 and earlier yield tests had already been seen; this is disclosed.
blocks: non-overlapping 4-week blocks ending Friday. Predictors use data through the US session before that Friday; India yields lagged one full month; FPI flow lagged to last complete month

targets.rel4: NIFTY minus S&P log return, next 4 weeks
targets.link13: Fisher z of daily lag-aligned correlation over next 13 weeks, non-overlapping

split: dev 2015-2022, check 2023-01..2026-09. Oct-Nov 2026 is a case study only
pass: dev two-sided permutation p with Benjamini-Hochberg q<=0.10 across all predictor-target pairs, AND check same sign with one-sided p<0.10
ai_test: weekly NIFTY on S&P and (SOXX minus SPY). Pass: coefficient on chip excess < 0 with p<0.05 (HAC) in 2023-01..2026-09 AND in 2015-2022. Then Q4 2026 sign shown. Lead version: last week's chip excess on this week's NIFTY-S&P, same rule
detector: simulate a true correlation step 0.30 to -0.20 and measure delay and false alarms for 13w, 5w, EWMA halflife 10d
